div.font: Figure. PS-ROC pathogenicity score evaluation pipeline. ClinVar variants are filtered to a target gene set, labeled as pathogenic or benign, and annotated with prediction scores from dbNSFP. ROC analysis with bootstrap confidence intervals evaluates discriminative power. Supports single gene sets and multi-panel collection mode with cross-panel AUC comparison.
